summary: Expose invoice/billing metadata in admin console for finance ops
description:
Issue summary: Finance team needs easier access to invoice metadata (billing period, invoice id, linked subscription id, issuing region) from the admin console without having to pull raw CSVs or query internal APIs.

Impact: Reduces manual work for finance ops during month-end reconciliations and speeds up support investigation time when customers question invoice details. Current workaround requires engineering/ops to run ad-hoc queries or provide exported reports, which is time-consuming.

Environment: Admin console (internal), production billing DB, auth via SSO.

Steps to reproduce/workaround: 1) Finance requests invoice detail for a customer; 2) Support opens internal billing report spreadsheet or asks engineering to run query; 3) Export attached CSV and share.

Logs / data: Not applicable for bug reproduction.

Proposed solution: Add a restricted "Invoices" view in the admin console behind the finance role flag that surfaces: invoice_id, customer_account_id, billing_period_start/end, gross_amount, credits_applied, issuing_region, linked_subscription_ids, download PDF link, and reference to the original charge_id. Implement RBAC check (finance/admin) and paginate results. Start with a read-only view; no edits.

Acceptance criteria: - Finance role can view invoice list and click into invoice details for rows in the last 24 months. - Download link points to pre-signed PDF stored in internal S3. - Audit log entries recorded for invoice view events. - Feature behind feature-flag for safe rollout.

Notes: This is intentionally scoped as a UI + read-only API surface; any changes to billing calculations should not be part of this task. If backend indexes are required, follow up ticket will be created.
